description: This course explores advanced topics in artificial intelligence, including reinforcement learning algorithms like Q-learning and Deep Q-Networks; natural language processing techniques using transformer models such as BERT and GPT-3; computer vision applications with convolutional neural networks and YOLOv8; knowledge representation through ontologies and semantic web standards like RDF and OWL; and ethical AI frameworks with guidelines from IEEE and ISO standards. Students will engage with real-world datasets and implement AI solutions using Python, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.

clos.text: Define key concepts in reinforcement learning, including reward functions, discount factors, and exploration-exploitation trade-offs.
Describe the architecture and training process of transformer models for natural language processing tasks.
Explain the principles of convolutional neural networks and their application in object detection using YOLOv8.
Apply ethical AI frameworks to evaluate the societal impact of AI systems using IEEE and ISO standards.
Implement AI solutions for real-world problems using Python and deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch.

topics: Introduction to AI and Reinforcement Learning
Convolutional Neural Networks for Image Recognition
Ethical AI and Bias Mitigation Techniques
AI in Healthcare and Social Impact
